title: 15.36. Āsavavippayuttasāsavaduka, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Āsavavippayuttaṁ sāsavaṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca āsavavippayutto naanāsavo nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … ekaṁ.
Āsavavippayuttaṁ anāsavaṁ kusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca āsavavippayutto naanāsavo nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … ekaṁ. Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.
Āsavavippayuttaṁ sāsavaṁ akusalaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca āsavavippayutto naanāsavo naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṁ …pe… avigate ekaṁ.

Āsavavippayuttaṁ sāsavaṁ abyākataṁ dhammaṁ paccayā āsavavippayutto nasāsavo naabyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Āsavavippayuttaṁ sāsavaṁ abyākataṁ dhammaṁ paccayā āsavavippayutto naanāsavo naabyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā …. Hetuyā dve …pe… avigate dve.
